label: High Distress and Loneliness
summary: This profile is characterized by elevated loneliness alongside comparatively high depressive and anxiety symptoms, indicating a respondent group experiencing substantial emotional distress.
demographic_anchor: Female, graduate education or above, and more than 5 hours
behavior_markers: Represents a relatively large subgroup in the training split (n=165)

label: Low distress, low loneliness profile
summary: Respondents in this profile show comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms overall.
demographic_anchor: Most closely anchored to male respondents with graduate-level education or above and 1–3 hours in the referenced time-use category.
behavior_markers: Reports lower UCLA-8 loneliness scores than more distressed profiles
Shows low PHQ-9 depressive symptom levels
Shows very low GAD-7 anxiety symptom levels
Represents a relatively low-distress respondent group overall

label: Profile 2: Lonely but low distress
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness while showing relatively low average depressive and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Most clearly anchored by female respondents with graduate-level education or above and 1-3 hours in the referenced time-use category.
behavior_markers: Emotional pattern suggests social disconnection without similarly elevated general distress indicators
tone: Socially disconnected, but otherwise psychologically relatively stable on depression and anxiety measures.
